extracted.name: Grilled Potato Salad
extracted.description: This grilled potato salad recipe with bacon, green onion, garlic, and parsley is an easy, fuss-free way to prepare and enjoy potato salad all summer long.
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Place potatoes in a large bowl; add 2 tablespoons olive oil and toss to coat.
Cook on the preheated grill until tender, about 30 minutes. Cool, 10 to 15 minutes, cut into quarters, then place in a large bowl.
Whisk ½ cup olive oil, vinegar, salt, black pepper, garlic, and sugar together in a bowl until smooth; pour over potatoes. Add bacon, green onions, and parsley; toss until evenly coated.
